answer_1.quote: A key sub-task of related work generation is citation text generation -generating citation text for pre-selected cited papers given the context of the citing paper ...
answer_1.outputs: citation sentences or paragraphs (citation texts) generated for the cited papers

answer_2.quote: CITEBENCH uses two quantitative evaluation metrics to estimate the performance of the models. ROUGE measures the n-gram overlap ... BERTScore uses contextual embeddings to calculate a similarity score ...

answer_4.quote: Three human annotators have manually inspected 25 baseline outputs from each of the best-performing ... each output was rated on a 5-point scale in terms of readability and consistency.
answer_4.guideline: Readability scores were defined on a 5-point scale from 1 (unreadable) to 5 (perfectly readable). Consistency scores were defined on a 5-point scale from 1 (not related) to 5 (conveys the same message and detail as the original text).
